drawings.title: Hidden-line view
drawings.blurb: The pillow block from the camera its render uses, the edges behind the part dashed.

drawings.title: One camera, two kinds of output
drawings.blurb: A path-traced picture of a knurled thumbscrew and its nut, and the line drawing of the same model from the same parallel camera: edges in sight solid, edges behind dashed, the thread inside the nut among them. Drag the handle between the two. Zoomed in this far the picture has run out of pixels; the lines are drawn again at every size.
drawings.alt: A knurled brass thumbscrew with a steel hex nut, as a rendered picture on one side of a handle and as a line drawing with dashed hidden edges on the other

drawings.title: Dimensioned three-view sheet
drawings.blurb: Front, top, right and a pictorial view on a letter-size sheet, dimensioned in inches.

drawings.title: Hatched section
drawings.blurb: The part cut across its bore: the cut face outlined heavily and hatched, the housing beyond drawn behind it, dimensioned.

cards.title: Hidden-line view
cards.blurb: A line drawing from any camera angle, with the edges behind the part dashed.
cards.alt: A line drawing of a pillow block seen from above and to one side, hidden edges dashed.

cards.title: Dimensioned sheet
cards.blurb: Front, top and right views on one sheet, dimensioned in inches, as SVG, PDF and DXF.
cards.alt: A drawing sheet with top, front, right and pictorial views of a pillow block, seven dimensions, the bore and slots called out.

cards.title: Hatched section

cards.alt: A section across a pillow block through its bore and slots, the cut material hatched, with six dimensions and centre lines.
